text: mustafa's daughter starts reception on 3rd sept, he's more nervous than she is lol. text him that morning

phoebe got made redundant fri, whole team gone in one mtg, 20 mins and done. took it ok on the phone but def not ok, kept saying she's fine. her and her partner just bought the flat in march too so the mortgage is a worry. she's got a meeting w HR on the 4th at 3pm about the package. her mum keeps ringing her which isnt helping
giulia playing the brahms at her recital 14 Nov 7pm st john's. she's terrified, hasn't played solo in yrs
nikolai's dad passed away last wk. funeral is thurs at 11 at the crem on hill rd. need to sort a card b4 then
eilidh and dafydd split up. she's moved back to her mum's in perth for now
mihai running the half marathon sun 12th, first one. wants sub 2hrs. ask how it went monday
mateo graduated!! ceremony was today, his mum flew over from bogota for it. send congrats
santiago - big gig at the jazz cafe 22/11, doors 8. he's sorted me a guest list spot
joanna's lad sat his driving test this morning, failed on a roundabout. gutted. she says he's rebooked for 9 Jan
haruto into the final of the regional chess comp, sat 30th at 10am in leeds. his wife Rana going too. dont forget to wish him luck fri night

cem lost his job at the warehouse, whole site closing end of nov. 3 kids and his wife's only part time. he was there 14 yrs, started as a picker and worked up to shift mgr. he's applying everywhere but says nobody's hiring b4 xmas. his eldest has her mocks in jan too. check in w him next wk, maybe ask my boss if they need anyone

dimitri's grandma died over the wkend, she was 94. he was close to her, she basically raised him. funeral prob next tues or weds, he'll confirm. i should ask if he needs anything for the wake, he mentioned doing all the food himself
reza nervous re his son's gcse results thurs 21st aug. kid wants to do sciences at college
remind me to ring ibrahim tmrw at lunch about the funeral arrangements for his uncle

amy's play opens 5th of dec at the little theatre, she's lady macbeth!! runs till the 9th, matinee sat at 2.30. she's been learning lines on the bus every morning for wks. cast party after the last show on the sat, she said bring someone. get tickets for thurs night w the others, and flowers for after
yasmin and her husband had their little girl's first day at nursery today, she cried, yasmin cried more
rhys match cancelled sat due to waterlogged pitch, rescheduled to 18/11 at 2
yusuf passed his finals, first class. graduation is 16 July
shira's dog Biscuit had to be put down yesterday. she's in bits. maybe send flowers

ali splitting w zainab after 6 yrs. didnt see that coming at all, they were at the bbq in aug looking totally fine. house going on the market in the new yr. he's staying at his brother Omar's for a bit, sleeping on the sofa bed. they're sharing the dog for now. he's not told his parents yet
esme's recital went really well apparently, ask her for the video
bruno ran the brighton 10k in 52 mins, PB. he wants a garmin for xmas, keeps dropping hints
kevin's mum's funeral moved to the 28th at half 1. wake at the red lion
omar's son kofi starts big school in sept, uniform shopping saturday. omar finds it all v emotional
dafydd singing w the male voice choir at the eisteddfod 4 aug, he's been rehearsing every tues & thurs
moira's husband died in the spring. first xmas without him coming up. pop round to see her early dec
bilal's leaving do for the redundancy thing is fri 7th at 6pm, the anchor. everyone chipping in for a gift, i said i'd sort the card
dentist appt 14/11 at 9.40. also renew car insurance b4 the 20th
took the bins out, need to buy milk, bread, oat stuff

ok so phoebe rang again. interview for a new role at the council wed 19th at 10am, first since the redundancy. she's really anxious about it, hasn't interviewed in like 12 yrs. said she'd send me her cv to look over tmrw evening. her sister Giulia is helping w prep too. need to text her good luck tues night and then ring thurs to see how it went
giulia nailed the recital apparently, standing ovation. her mum was there crying

nikolai back at work mon, a wk after the funeral. told me he's not sleeping, up at 4 every night. his mum's staying w him for now which helps. he's a big fulham fan, maybe get tickets for a home game in dec to get him out the house
mihai did 1:58!! sub 2. buy him a pint
santiago's band gig got pulled, venue double booked. new date tbc

mrs garcia from next door - her grandson Mateo graduates from cardiff 20th July, law, first in the family to go to uni. she's so proud, told me 3 times over the fence. she's going up on the train the day before w her daughter and staying 2 nights. she asked if i'd water the tomatoes while she's away, said yes
joanna says her daughter has her 11 plus on the 12th sept at half 9. she's stressing more than the kid
amy's lady macbeth was class. she's got another audition for the rep co 2nd of feb
haruto came second at the chess thing! money prize too. congratulate him next time i see him
cem had his first interview since losing the warehouse job, says it went ok. hear back by fri
rhys - match on the 18th, kick off 2. he's captain now. his wife Esme always brings the kids
ibrahim's uncle's funeral sat 10am at the mosque on park st, burial after. i'm driving his mum
rana's little boy losing his first tooth was a whole event lol. tooth fairy left a fiver apparently
yusuf's graduation 16 July 11am, he got me a ticket. need to book the day off work
zainab's cat Mango went missing tues night. she's put posters up all over. text her tonight to see if any luck

dimitri's grandma's funeral confirmed weds 12th at 2pm, greek orthodox church on the high st. wake at his aunt's after. he's doing a reading and is dreading it, never spoken in public. his cousins flying in from thessaloniki tues. dont forget to ask him what i can bring, and text him weds morning
kofi (omar's boy) did his first swimming gala sat, came 3rd in backstroke. omar sent me a video, so proud
reza's son got 9s in all his sciences!! off to college to do a levels
moira likes those lavender things from the garden centre, xmas idea
bilal starts the new job 6th jan, project mgr at a firm in salford. relieved after the redundancy

kevin - Kev - doing the great north run next sept for his mum's hospice. he's started training already, 3 runs a wk, never run further than the bus stop b4 lol. says it gives him something to focus on since the funeral. he's got a justgiving page up. sponsor him on payday and share it in the work group chat
esme's first day at secondary 4 sept, she's nervous but rhys says she's excited really. i should get her a little good luck card
shira says she's not ready for another dog. still too raw. she's going to her sister Yasmin's in manchester for a few days to get away
mustafa said it all went fine at school, his girl loves her teacher. he was more of a wreck than her
gym mon wed fri 7am from next wk. meal prep sundays
eilidh doing ok. new job at the uni in sept, admin in the music dept
mateo's mum stayed on for 2 wks after the graduation, he's taking her to edinburgh tues to fri. she's never been
santiago messaged - gig back on, 6th dec at 8pm same venue. still on the guest list
ali says he's ok but he's clearly not, didnt eat a thing. his brother Omar worried too. need to call him sun afternoon
tickets for the panto 27 dec 2pm, 2 adults 2 kids, booked. pick up at box office
amy's audition on 2nd feb at 11 in bristol. she's nervous so text her the night b4. and remind me to ask her after how it went. her partner Mihai driving her down
